messages:
zoe: opened PR to update the model catalog + model card for zenith7b variants. focus: supported context limits, embedding/seq shard notes, bench appendix, and compatibility table for private runtimes. PR: https://git.company/redwood/docs/pull/5302 :wave:
amar: nice. is this touching the embedding sharding guidance too? we had a customer hit a hard 128k token embed sharding bug.
zoe: yes 12 added a short section under 'limits' describing how embedding sharding interacts with quantized variants and the recommended `shard_margin` for heavy documents.
fin: can you paste the short bench summary here? folks will want numbers to back recommended defaults.
zoe: pasted brief appendix in PR: g5.12x: zenith7b baseline p95 = 510ms, zenith7b-int8 p95 = 420ms, zenith7b+adapter (merged) p95 = 560ms. embed throughput (documents/sec): baseline = 38, int8 = 46. note: sharded-embed overhead ~8% when using 3-way shard.
kai: add a compatibility callout: private agents < v1.7.0 treat `+adapter` as incompatible and will fall back to base or skip shards. that's spawned a few support threads.
zoe: added compatibility table mapping runtime versions -> adapter + shard behavior and a short upgrade checklist for customers. also added a sample Terraform route block for infra teams.
amar: can we include a Python SDK snippet showing explicit fallback order and embed sharding params? makes it copy/paste friendly.
zoe: added Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${RW_API_KEY}")
resp = client.generate(
    model="zenith7b+adapter:aurora-x",
    fallback_policy=["zenith7b-int8","zenith7b"],
    route_options={"max_total_tokens": 8192, "embed_shard_count": 3, "embed_shard_margin": 0.1}
)
print(resp.output_text)
```
fin: nice. support will want a CLI smoke for quick repros.
zoe: added CLI: `rwctl infer --model zenith7b+adapter:aurora-x --input-file notes.md --max-tokens 256 --prefer-quant-fallback` and an embed-run: `rwctl embed --model zenith7b-int8 --file bigdoc.txt --shard-count 3`
fin: editorial: prefer phrase "aims to preserve intent" for quality fallback messaging. avoid absolutes.
zoe: updated wording to "aims to preserve intent but may alter phrasing and tokenization; run the example eval set to validate."
docs-ci-bot: PR 5302 docs build: success \u2705 - preview: https://docs-preview.company/5302
release-bot: flagged for next minor release notes: note about private runtime caveat + embed-shard guidance.
amar: QA want a 5-prompt eval set and a tiny smoke script that fails if mean delta >5%. add that under examples/zenith-evals.md?
zoe: added 5 prompts and a tiny Node smoke file in the repo. linked results: https://ci.company/qa-runs/12077 (quick run passed, mean delta 2.9%).
kai: LGTM. can you also add a one-line troubleshooting FAQ in the model card: "If you see unexpected truncation, check runtime version and shard settings."
zoe: added FAQ line. merging after release notes ack. thanks all :shipit:
